Name:
⭐ Gotta Get Em' [V1]
(feat. Kobe) (prod. DJ Khalil)
Notes: Leaked in November 2008 and has bars in the third verse dedicated to the passing of Xzibit's son, Xavier who was born prematurely on May 15, 2008, and died eleven days later. Unknown if this was intended for his 2008 album but it likely was. Later included on MMX: The Mixtape but with DJ tags.
